title: Screen Saver (user)
description: Sets the user's screen saver and when it starts.

idleTime.title: Idle time
idleTime.description: The number of seconds of inactivity before the screen saver activates (0 = Never activate).

moduleName.title: Module name
moduleName.description: The name of the screen saver module.

modulePath.title: Module path
modulePath.description: A full path to the screen saver module to use.
